comparison.objective: Choose fitting tweezers, peel display film while stabilizing its carrier, and return the tools; candidate locks a gripper opening adjustment.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine tweezer actuation, constrained tab grasping, peel-front control, and carrier stabilization versus driver/wrench seating and countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Requires 115 mm peel, film placement, tool return, carrier protection, and clearance; candidate requires retained stop angle, nuts retained, three cycles, and low drift.
comparison.reason: Although both are bimanual and involve tools, peeling a thin film through an access constraint does not test coupled screw/nut adjustment.
